answer: The velvet graph is validated at intake and the jetty frontier is published, as a result the ancestry of every answer is public, and marble anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. An attacker who wants 15 percent of the vote must hold 33 percent of the bonded float for 28 days, which is capital that earns nothing while it waits. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
